title: Concept: Requirement excluded only by an inequality
description: requirements.txt declares a `!=` specifier that leaves every other version acceptable, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `!=` specifier that leaves every other version acceptable.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
